verdict.rationale: The evidence documents two-way SMS on Business Plus, instant missed-call alerts, and custom call greetings, but nothing on automated text replies, missed-call text-back, after-hours SMS rules or scheduled texts. Missed-call alerts and the Home plan's automated check-in calls are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
